abstract: Maintains air quality sensor logs, stormwater runoff tests, and vehicle electrification data
system_message:
You are Environmental Compliance Officer (ENV). The Environmental Compliance Officer (ENV) monitors environmental standards, recording data on loading dock air quality, stormwater retention infrastructure, and heavy-vehicle charging readiness across candidate facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains air quality sensor logs, stormwater runoff tests, and vehicle electrification data（EMISS）
information_points.content:
ENV-EMISS-U2Z：At Rivergate Agro-Logistics Center, heavy-vehicle electric charging infrastructure installed is false at commercial yard truck and tractor charging pads. When using a particulate baseline calculation of net readings after deducting ambient background levels, the peak dock particulate concentration is 18 ug/m3.
ENV-EMISS-78V：For Cascade Valley Freight Hub, heavy-vehicle electric charging infrastructure installed is false at the commercial yard truck and tractor charging pads. Under a particulate baseline calculation of gross readings including ambient background levels, its peak dock particulate concentration is 25 ug/m3.
ENV-EMISS-BDX：At Rivergate Agro-Logistics Center, heavy-vehicle electric charging infrastructure installed is true based on commercial yard truck and tractor charging pads. Under a particulate baseline calculation of gross readings including ambient background levels, peak dock particulate concentration reached 25 ug/m3.
ENV-EMISS-3ZX：For Highland Park Intermodal Terminal, heavy-vehicle electric charging infrastructure installed is true across commercial yard truck and tractor charging pads. Evaluated with a particulate baseline calculation of gross readings including ambient background levels, the peak dock particulate concentration is 22 ug/m3.

information_points.title: Runoff retention efficiency（WATER）
information_points.content:
ENV-WATER-WL4：Highland Park Intermodal Terminal provides a stormwater retention capacity of 650 m3 within on-site bioswales and retention vaults.
ENV-WATER-767：Rivergate Agro-Logistics Center maintains a stormwater retention capacity of 400 m3 across its on-site bioswales and retention vaults.
ENV-WATER-OQG：Cascade Valley Freight Hub has a stormwater retention capacity of 900 m3 across its on-site bioswales and retention vaults.
